newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK HEAD SEES KROON FIXED UNTIL EU LINK.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK HEAD SEES KROON FIXED UNTIL EU LINK.

text.p: Estonia's central bank governor Vahur Kraft said on Friday that Estonia would retain is currency board system and fixed exchange rate until the country joined the European Union (EU).
"Our policy is clear. We will continue with our currency board system and fixed exchange rate," Kraft told Reuters in an interview.
"Theoretically we can use this forever but of course what is our hope is that when we can join the European Union monetary system we will change this system.
"Until then we will use the same system. It is quite clear."
Kraft said the fixed exchange rate, with the kroon pegged to the mark at eight to one, gave the country stability.
He said this valuation was fair.
"We are quite sure that we won't change our policy. We are not talking about devaluation or revaluation," he said.
